title: Search exact compatible realtime inventory

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Exact realtime search tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_realtime_search.py

evidence_required: FT-004-AC-001 RED: no processing application boundary performs realtime exact compatible search; GREEN: mixed revision, SPA, date, visibility, processing-state and confirmed/unconfirmed time fixtures prove every scope filter precedes exact cosine comparison and only compatible active ready inventory participates through the immutable native revision; decisive comparison: returned match observations and query trace versus fixture truth; artifact: focused pytest under .tasks/TASK-070-T2-FT-004-W2/.

FT-004-AC-002 RED: the admitted nonzero proposal path has no independent server search result; GREEN: the completed reference selector feeds every selected gate-passing detection independently into exact search, applies query quality and calibrated threshold, returns explicit rejected detections and contains no margin/tracking/clustering/cross-pipeline path; decisive comparison: ordered/repeated/low-quality fixtures and per-detection call/result trace; artifact: focused pytest under .tasks/TASK-070-T2-FT-004-W2/.
purpose: Implement the processing-owned exact scoped reference search and return complete typed threshold-valid match observations to promo.
success_outcome: Each selected acceptable occurrence searches only the immutable compatible ready Photo scope with exact cosine comparison and returns deterministic per-Photo matches plus pHash ranking observations without foreign writes.
anti_goals: Do not assemble the global union, select final teasers, compute N or publish a session.
Do not add ANN, caching, weak-match admission, margin logic or an optional time filter without confirmed clock evidence.
Do not mutate Photo visibility, serving settings or Promo-owned state.

forbidden_scope: Promo result assembly, session persistence and Attempt transitions
Inventory Photo activation or visibility mutation
stop_conditions: Exact scope cannot be expressed through the accepted inventory/serving projections.
Search requires a new module or unregistered dependency edge.
A result would need to mix revisions or admit a weak candidate.

constraints: Read mutable truth from face_moment.photos, face_moment.photo_pipeline_states and face_moment.photo_faces through processing-owned repository integration; prove real read behavior in a uniquely named disposable PostgreSQL database and clean only task fixtures.
Read private ready previews through the existing object-store adapter for deterministic opencv_phash64_v1 computation; pHash has no persistence lifecycle.
Group multiple face rows from one Photo to its best cosine similarity once per selected detection and use deterministic similarity/photo_id ties.
invariants: Scope filters occur before distance comparison and no unconfirmed clock creates a time window.
pHash ranks only threshold-valid Photos and cannot admit a candidate.
The processing response contains no session, global union, final teaser set, N, QR or display state.
verification_targets: FT-004-AC-001 mixed-scope repository integration proves exact filtering before comparison.
FT-004-AC-002 integrated selection/search fixtures prove independent native queries, gates and forbidden-path absence.
